component.name: Umbral Browser
component.summary: A focused, privacy-minded browser built on Zen Browser and Firefox

description.p: Umbral is an independent browser project with a clean, customizable interface and privacy-minded defaults. It includes the Umbral homepage, Firefox Enhanced Tracking Protection, the original signed uBlock Origin extension, and configurable search including user-provided SearXNG instances.
Privacy statistics show Firefox ETP-classified records for the last seven UTC dates. They are not advertisements or uBlock Origin block counts.
